source_of_truth: GitHub repository state plus authoritative documents listed below

definition_of_done.product_reality: follow docs/AGENT_DEVELOPMENT_POLICY.md and docs/PROJECT_STATUS.md: Unreal Product Reality is pre-merge when those governing docs require it; parallel-safe exceptions apply only when every documented condition is satisfied

verification.rule: never convert missing human evidence into PASS; keep implementation status separate from Product Reality acceptance

executable_lanes.evidence: Deterministic production simulation covers current mining/storage/manipulator/damage/save-load state through the canonical simulation suite

active_work_sources: open issues with active implementation evidence
work_ownership.rule: do not duplicate or compete with active work; prefer finishing existing work

regression_memory.rule: record significant or recurring reproduced failures with root cause, fix, verification, regression protection, and residual risk

readiness_scoring.rule: report unknown when evidence is insufficient

continuation: derive from current roadmap/issues with earliest incomplete vertical-slice acceptance first

portfolio_aggregation.rule: aggregate only verified repository evidence; never infer missing component state

golden_scenarios.rule: engine-independent deterministic scenario is automated; Unreal compile/playtest remains separately tracked Product Reality according to governing policy

preflight.policy: ordinary PRs require GREEN full preflight evidence on the exact head; use PREFLIGHT_UNVERIFIED only for a legitimate environment limitation and record the reason

promotion.rule: advance only from verified evidence; never skip FAILED/PENDING/UNCERTAIN gates

orchestration.rule: automatic promotion is limited to orchestrator-owned branches; Product Reality PASS requires concrete evidence; status reconciliation opens a PR rather than pushing directly to main

growth_engine.ranking_rule: recommend highest-value reversible work from live evidence; P0/P1/existing ownership gates remain authoritative and recommendations never bypass preflight, CI, reviews, architecture, security, provenance, privacy, or Product Reality policy
growth_engine.specialist_lane_rule: parallel lanes may be proposed only when they do not overlap active PR ownership or each other; one scheduler retains merge authority
growth_engine.learning_rule: record verified failures, root causes, successful repairs, regression protection, and residual risk; never store secrets or private Product Reality payloads
growth_engine.dependency_rule: prefer slices that unblock more downstream work when priority and risk are otherwise comparable
growth_engine.sentinel_rule: surface architecture/security/governance/readiness drift only from observable evidence; do not fabricate percentages or acceptance

execution_director.action_policy: P0/P1 remediation and active PR ownership always precede new roadmap slices; only a clean ownership/remediation state may EXECUTE_NEXT_SLICE
execution_director.learning_policy: derive sanitized workflow/review lessons automatically; the hourly portfolio orchestrator may persist only meaningful verified lessons into learning-memory
execution_director.product_reality_policy: harvest only private/local evidence inboxes into sanitized attestations; never infer PASS and never commit private evidence payloads
execution_director.dispatch_policy: specialist lanes are conflict-aware reservations under one scheduler and are never independent merge authorities
execution_director.sentinel_policy: REMEDIATE for material repeated failures or P0/P1 drift, HOLD for WIP pressure, ESCALATE only reserved human decisions
